context.scope: Actual production MAIN owner and all TRAP schema fields against the existing byte helper: signed/unsigned casts, integer operators, packed bits, aggregate addresses, complete initialized static-table bytes, fixed entry ownership. Scratch record states are component fixtures, not natural gameplay; recordings and original-C action tests are separate.

actualOriginalCActions.scope: Actual MAIN hero and source-created monster; source trap creation/linking, hero effects/reset/deletion and monster immunity/harmlessness/effects/deletion for web, bear, squeaky-board and rust traps. Complete world graph, both ISAAC states and ordered logs at each action, plus terminal/input/frames compare with original C. Other effects, every tool/form/level-transition branch and hidden recordings are not claimed.

ordinaryTurns.scope: Real initial walk, wait and forced attack; input through pending output and next read. Generic C field access and pointer-table dispatch are also counted; C malloc includes this runtime's C-stack allocations. Counters are architectural acceptance, not CPU or timing samples.

movementStatus.scope: Source make_confused/make_stunned/reset at declared real command input boundaries, with actual changed-direction RNG. Complete command snapshots, world graph, both ISAAC states/logs, terminal bytes/frames and raw More input match original C. No fabricated map/monster or raw status-field writes. This does not cover all water/air turbulence, punishment, bars or polymorph combinations.

limitations: No 20x or zero-bridge/zero-allocation claim. Shared native record views still access typed memory; foreign byte locals/copies/callbacks and other generic engine paths remain. All hidden recordings and every trap/tool/form/transition have not been exercised.
